sources.label: BigSpy home
sources.claim: BigSpy positions itself as a free-entry ad spy and ad library tool covering 10 major platforms, with competitor ad tracking, niche market research, and a creative library it describes as over 1 billion creatives.

sources.label: BigSpy pricing
sources.claim: BigSpy's published plans are Free, Starter at $69/month, Growth at $159/month, and Ultimate at $499/month, with annual and group-buy offers.
